At 03:30. The red retracing made the left side of the last @y angular instead of round, but iy must be @y. The first gallows is definitely two-legged, but the left loop may have been lost, so it just may be a @t not a @k. The second gallows is definitely two-legged and without the platform slash, but it is not clear whether it is @t, @k, or something else. The retracing also made the final glyph be like a question mark (&385;) that may have been an @s o r@r.
At 06:30. The first glyph is missshapen and it is Not clear what it was supposed to be. The end of the first word looks like @a in red but a very faint @y-plume is visible in brown. So it's @y.
